scope: Primary author repositories/papers and official docs only; no third-party code executed; no weights loaded

references.observed: Patched decoder-only model, causal temporal and cross-variate attention, direct multi-step quantiles; code uses running statistics, masks and RMS normalization.
references.transfer: Separate time/variable roles and availability masks; forecast quantiles rather than precise future wicks.
references.limit: 330M published model trained on >1 trillion time points is not evidence of an appropriate Babel scale. Marginal quantiles are not a joint sampled path. No pretrained weights downloaded.

references.observed: Group attention shares information across variables/related series; time mask expansion is not a per-bar causal contract; RoPE and T5-style RMS normalization in implementation.
references.transfer: Price/activity/context mixing with explicit same-origin availability.
references.limit: Forecasting at the observed endpoint does not qualify all interior representations as causal. Historical and future-known covariates must be distinguished. Forecasting benchmark wins do not certify trading or compressed state quality.

references.observed: Ordered temporal patches; channel-independent encoder reshapes batch*variables; prediction head can flatten the whole sequence.
references.transfer: Preserve ordering when grouping remote context; cost-aware comparison.
references.limit: Our patch/local4 trials already exist and were not balanced wins. Do not repeat them under a new name. OHLCV are coupled; entire-sequence decoder is not a one-vector decoder.

references.observed: Timestamp representations with contextual and hierarchical consistency; default convolutions have symmetric padding.
references.transfer: Timestamp-level reusable state and explicitly scoped shared-content comparisons.
references.limit: Past work already examined overlap; no direct reuse of default interior states or forcing full vectors equal across resolutions.

references.observed: xLSTM multivariate recurrent design; official docs explicitly say public forecast API recomputes its context and does not expose state-carrying incremental forecasts.
references.transfer: Retain recurrent memory as F02 candidate if measured streaming cost warrants it.
references.limit: Paper and docs reviewed; no kernel-level audit or real-weight execution. Do not assume public embedding equals all recurrent memory.

references.observed: Latent dynamics uses deterministic and stochastic components in an action-conditioned control setting.
references.transfer: Differentiate observed state updates from uncertain imagined future transitions.
references.limit: OHLCV/OI lack identified market actions, order book and exogenous interventions; not evidence we can reconstruct buying/selling agents or simulate causal market mechanics.

references.observed: Proper scoring rules evaluate conditional distributions, including log score and CRPS.
references.transfer: Evaluate calibration and sharpness plus proper score, not a handpicked plausible trajectory or just direction accuracy.
references.limit: Marginal calibration alone does not establish joint path dependence, rare-event quality or trading value.

references.observed: DataDownloader period is seconds; date arguments refer to trading days, datetime without timezone defaults to Beijing; open/close OI refer to start/end holdings.
references.transfer: Retain source clocks, true availability, session calendars, volume sums and OI endpoints.
references.limit: Historical session changes, volume counting regimes and official main mapping release times remain to be qualified from appropriate source metadata.
